title_zh: 美国宣布新一批对乌军事援助包
title_en: US announces new military aid package to Ukraine
summary_zh: 美方宣布包含防空系统与前装弹药的援助包，金额待国会确认。
summary_en: The US announced an aid package including air-defense systems and munitions; amount pending congressional confirmation.
source_third: 美国国防部 / 媒体汇总

title_zh: 俄军无人机袭击中部电网致多地停电
title_en: RU drone strike on central grid causes blackouts
summary_zh: 乌克兰方面称俄军一夜之间发射多架无人机袭击变电站，五州限电。
summary_en: Ukraine reports RU drones struck substations overnight, causing outages in five regions.

title_zh: 国际刑事法院就战争罪调查发布进展
title_en: ICC publishes update on war-crimes investigations
summary_zh: ICC 更新对冲突中涉嫌战争罪行的调查进展，涉及多起基础设施与平民目标袭击。
summary_en: The ICC updated investigations into alleged war crimes, including strikes on civilian infrastructure.

title_zh: 联合国更新乌克兰境内流离失所人数
summary_zh: UNHCR 更新数据显示境内流离失所人数较上月上升，重建进度缓慢。
summary_en: UNHCR data shows internally displaced persons up from last month; reconstruction lags.

title_zh: 顿涅茨克方向战线推进说法不一
title_en: Conflicting claims on Donetsk front advances
summary_zh: 乌方称击退俄方进攻；俄方称占领若干据点。双方说法分歧，需独立源交叉核验。
summary_en: UA says it repelled RU assaults; RU claims seizing positions. Claims diverge; verify with independent sources.
disagreement_note_zh: 乌方称击退、俄方称占领，控制线表述相互矛盾；以 DeepState/ISW 独立地图为准。
